T0.1.title: depcruise tsconfig fix + madge warn-only gate
T0.1.blocked_reason: PLAN-DEFECT (cycle-implement Stop Condition #4): Plan T0.1 premise is that .dependency-cruiser.cjs has a silent tsconfig parse failure causing it to miss 13 cycles that madge catches. Reality: config lines 78-86 EXPLICITLY skip tsConfig parse with documented rationale (`Loading tsconfig.json here would require it to resolve extends ../../tsconfig.base.json from workspace root CWD, which breaks depcruise's path resolver`). Audit Phase 5 cartographer misdiagnosed the root cause. The prescribed fix (add try/catch require.resolve for tsconfig) would re-break depcruise per the existing comment's warning. Empirically confirmed iter 1: madge=13 cycles, depcruise=`no dependency violations found` (364 modules / 762 deps cruised). Real disagreement root cause unknown — possible candidates: (a) different scan algorithm (madge uses dependency-tree library), (b) enhancedResolveOptions filters out some files, (c) no-circular rule's from:{} matcher behavior with the actual graph. Recommend loop back to cycle-plan for revised diagnosis. Workaround that does NOT require plan revision: add madge as INDEPENDENT secondary gate alongside depcruise (skipping tsconfig changes entirely), achieving the plan's intent (CI catches cycles) via different mechanism.
